questions.stem: What are the conditions for catalytic cracking?

options.text: About 850 degrees C with steam and no catalyst
About 300 degrees C with a phosphoric acid catalyst
Room temperature with a nickel catalyst
About 500 degrees C with a zeolite catalyst

questions.explanation: Catalytic cracking uses a zeolite (aluminosilicate) catalyst at about 500 degrees C and slight pressure. The catalyst lowers the activation energy needed to break C-C bonds. Steam cracking (the other method) uses higher temperatures (~850 degrees C) with steam but no catalyst.
